issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop.' emitted twice from FahrkontrolleTab render. Root cause: line ~266 in FahrkontrolleTab.jsx uses a bare React fragment '<>' inside the categoriesSorted.map() – fragments cannot receive a key so React falls back to array index. Fix: replace '<>...</>' with '<React.Fragment key={cat.id}>...</React.Fragment>'. Non-blocking (renders correctly) but pollutes DevTools console.

action_items: MINOR – Fix React key warning in FahrkontrolleTab.jsx: change `<>` (fragment) inside categoriesSorted.map() to `<React.Fragment key={cat.id}>` so the two child rows (cat header + subitem rows wrapper) get a stable key. Same file line ~266.
critical_code_review_comments: students.py delete_student is correct: purges student_lessons + student_assessments in the same handler. Nice.

fahrkontrolle.py upsert_assessment: the DB has a unique index on (student_id, subitem_id, lesson_id) — the code correctly finds existing by that key and updates in place. However the '' empty-clear branch only triggers when BOTH value AND comment are empty; a client sending value='' with a non-empty comment would still upsert a row with value=''. Behaves as designed per spec.

assessments upsert uses `updated_at` on update but the model default_factory sets it at insert time — verified the update-branch explicitly sets updated_at=now, and the insert-branch passes updated_at=now to Assessment(...). Consistent.
FahrkontrolleTab.jsx – React key warning on fragment inside .map(). Cosmetic but should be fixed (see action item).

FkCategoryCreate/PatchCreate is reused for PATCH which means the client must send title_de + order every time (order can't be omitted). Consider a dedicated FkCategoryPatch with all optional fields for safer partial updates. Not blocking today because the FE always sends both.
MasterDataTab is fully functional with add/rename/reorder/delete – 12 route items rendered, 6 categories rendered, subitems filter by category selection.
AdminStudentDetail sets default active tab to 'fahrkontrolle' (not 'overview'). This is intentional per iteration spec and confirmed working.

Login flow redirects to '/' instead of '/admin' after successful login. Not a bug per spec – Nadine can click the admin toolbar 'Verwaltung' link or navigate directly to /admin. But the review spec says 'on redirect to /admin'. Recommend main agent verify login redirect target — if intended /admin, adjust AdminLogin.jsx post-login navigation.

rca of the issue: No bugs found. Minor React key warning in FahrkontrolleTab.jsx (bare '<>' fragment inside .map() lacks a key). Reproduction: open any student's Fahrkontrolle tab with the browser DevTools console open — the warning appears twice. Mitigation: replace the fragment with `<React.Fragment key={cat.id}>...</React.Fragment>` around the category header row + its subitem rows on line ~266 of /app/frontend/src/components/admin/students/FahrkontrolleTab.jsx.
